relationships.notes: EuroHPC states LUMI is hosted by CSC in Kajaani. Shared coordinates with the host are expected and are not a duplicate.
EuroHPC states JUPITER is hosted by the Jülich Supercomputing Centre.
Landlord and tenant, not one entity: Applied Digital owns the campus, CoreWeave contracts the 400 MW deployment.
Horizon 1 is a hall on the Childress campus, not a second site.
Prometheus is the named supercluster on the New Albany campus, not a second street address.
Talen: the AWS campus is adjacent to and powered by Susquehanna, behind the meter and later from the grid. This edge is what makes the station publishable.
TCEQ: the plant's electricity goes solely to the on-site AI data-center campus.
NIST EA identifies Fab 18 as the Model Fab copied for TSMC Arizona. Same company, different countries; not duplicates.
